title: RSI deep-buy: causal bullish divergence at RSI lows, matched vs no divergence (card rsi-deep-divergence-context, 7df5f6ee6)

what.name: Event
what.value_plain: close-pivot bullish divergence (price lower low, RSI higher low) on the six surviving cells; pivot known one bar later, fill at the next open
what.label: OURS

what.name: Control
what.value_plain: non-firing pivots of the same cell matched one-to-one on RSI (within 3 points) and trailing ATR%: divergence vs no divergence at the same level, TF and volatility
what.label: OURS

what.name: Context (8 features, completed bars)
what.value_plain: 1h..7d returns in ATR, 24h drawdown and sweep depth, decline speed and speed change, 5m range z, 30d vol percentile, volume / taker z, session; walk-forward ridge logistic
what.label: OURS

what.name: Costs
what.value_plain: 0.10% round trip; exit open N = 4 or 16 bars later
what.label: OURS

how: 144 variant rows with 30+ independent days on DEV; 36 pre-registered tests (divergence minus control at N=16, model minus level-only), Holm over all 36.
window: DEV = bar open < 2024-07-01 (frozen first); VALIDATION 2024-07-01..2025-06-30 read once; HOLDOUT never read

verdict.label: NULL: 0 of 144 rows fee-net above 0; 0 of 36 tests at Holm p < 0.05; ridge model beats level-only in 0 of 6 cells

why: Primary long rows at N=16: net negative in 6 of 6 cells; the divergence event sits below its matched control in 4 of 6 (worst 60m abs20: -1.51 [-2.98, -0.05] %).
VALIDATION: one cell (1m abs10) shows the model ahead on log-loss (t 1.98, 14 days) but its fee-net EV is -0.18 [-0.29, -0.06] % and it was never a DEV candidate: not kept.
A divergence at an RSI low on BTC 1m..60m does not, by itself, make the bounce tradeable after fees.
